Jae Park: us-west2: seeing ~40 pods stuck Pending with '0/48 nodes are available: 48 node(s) didn't match pod affinity/anti-affinity, taints' — dashboards show lots of free GPUs though. Anyone else seeing this?
Priya Nair: same. autoscaler logs show repeated scale-downs overnight. can you paste node/taint output?
Jae Park: pasted quick extract: ```
node-az1-001: taints=[preemptible=true:NoSchedule], labels={rack:r1, zone=us-west2-a}, allocatable=gpus=1
node-az1-002: taints=[], labels={rack:r1, zone=us-west2-a}, allocatable=gpus=1
node-az2-010: taints=[preemptible=true:NoSchedule], labels={rack:r3, zone=us-west2-b}, allocatable=gpus=1
node-az2-011: taints=[], labels={rack:r2, zone=us-west2-b}, allocatable=gpus=1
```
ops-bot: Alert: cluster-autoscaler scaled down 3 nodes (2026-03-19T23:12:02Z) — reason: low CPU for 10m.
Luis Mendez: my read: several workloads require "same-rack" affinity but nodes in the warm pool are labeled differently than on-demand; topologyKey mismatch + intermittent tolerations for the preemptible taint. scheduler then refuses to place and pods sit Pending. run: `kubectl get pods -o wide | grep Pending` to narrow.
Katie Chen: also observed conntrack spike during the scale events. CNI takes a beat to attach network for new nodes -> kubelet reports NotReady briefly and k8s taints/cordons kick in. that sequence amplifies fragmentation. check `conntrack -S` on the node.
Priya Nair: short mitigation: add a toleration for `preemptible=true:NoSchedule` for staging / non-critical batches and relax the affinity topologyKey to `topology.kubernetes.io/zone` so scheduler can fall back across racks. we'll try canary.
Jae Park: can we slow aggressive scale-down? cluster-autoscaler flags look like `--scale-down-unneeded-time=5m` currently. bump to `20m` and `--max-empty-bulk-delete=1` to reduce churn.
ops-bot: Note: estimated cost impact — fragmentation increased GPU idle by ~9% this week (~$1,800/week). ticket INFRA-2193 opened for investigation.
Luis Mendez: i'll run a relabel across warm-pool nodes to standardize `rack` labels and mark all spot GPUs consistently with `node.kubernetes.io/preemptible=true`. will also add a one-off script to migrate small jobs.
Jae Park: SGTM. i'll open a PR for autoscaler flags + a short runbook to tolerate preemptible taint on non-critical jobs. if the canary looks good we'll roll to us-west2. thanks :thumbsup:
